exposure: Maternal intake of dairy products during pregnancy (sufficient: >= 300 g/d vs. insufficient: < 300 g/d)
cohort: The study included 386 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) during their second trimester pregnancy.
finding: Women with GDM who consumed sufficient dairy products (>= 300 g/d) during the second trimester had an average reduction in neonatal birth weight of 93.1g and a lower risk of macrosomia.
mod_finding: Sufficient maternal dairy intake (>= 300 g/d) was associated with a lower risk of caesarean section in women with GDM.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, with specific analysis for macrosomia and low birth weight infants.
gest_age: Participants were women in their second trimester of pregnancy; preterm birth was assessed as an outcome.
